content.title: Game Recommendations
content.body:
## Overview

These games offer diverse experiences from relaxing to intellectually stimulating. Consider setting aside time to try each one.

## Recommended Games

- **Stardew Valley** - Addictive farming simulator, perfect for relaxing and charming gameplay.
- **Disco Elysium** - Unique detective RPG with phenomenal writing, blending philosophy and humor.
- **Hollow Knight** - Gorgeous metroidvania with challenging combat and an atmospheric world that encourages exploration.
